summary: Friendly, silly arcade golf. Easy to play, multiplayer or solo, online & offline
description: Flap. Glide. Dive. The easiest "golf" game to pick up and the hardest to put down. It's sort of golf anyway - if golf involved a bird, a lot of frantic flapping, and 40 gloriously silly courses. Master them solo, or flap circles around your friends. • Two buttons. One on each side of the screen. Tap one to flap in that direction. Hold it to glide. Hold both to dive bomb straight down. Now you know how to play! Easy peasy. • Glide and dive. Two new moves to the Flappy Golf series that let you sail across gaps and thread the perfect line to the cup. Simple controls get anyone playing, but you'll need to master these skills to prove you're a Superstar. • Solo or online. Dive into single player to unlock new courses and hone your skills. Then jump into online multiplayer to vibe out with friends - or get competitive in ranked matchmaking. • Two ways to play. Time your moves carefully to reach the cup in the fewest flaps, or get feathers flying in a race to the hole where you can flap as much as you want! • Show off your wings. Hatch eggs to get all kinds of birdies, from adorable to utterly cursed. Hunt for rare birdies or just fly your favorite. With over a billion combinations, you can be sure your most epic birdie is unlike anyone else's. • Keep coming back. Climb the ranks to Superstar, compete on the Weekly Course Challenge leaderboards, and save replays of your finest (or most disastrous) moments to share. • No Wi-Fi? No problem. Single player works offline so you can keep flapping in subway tunnels, on planes, and in the middle of the forest. • Cross-platform. Play with your friends on mobile, tablet, and Mac - and pick up right where you left off on any device. • Free to play. You can't buy a skill advantage, just legendary birdies and more ways to show off your style. And a one-time Premium Unlock kills the ads for good and throws in a few extra goodies. Try out the latest Flappy Golf now! With over 17 million downloads across the series and counting, you know it's going to be hard to put down. Happy Flapping! ✌️
